servers.name: VehicleState
servers._comment_major: SYS-002 3.1 requires Major Version 1. This must be carried in the SD OFFER entry: vsomeip's routing_manager_impl::add_routing_info() only wires up a remote service (TCP connect -> on_availability) when the offered major equals the client's requested major, equals DEFAULT_MAJOR, or the client asked for ANY_MAJOR -- and vsomeip patches DEFAULT_MAJOR to 0x01 ("works better with autosar", interface/vsomeip/constants.hpp), so an offered major of 0 silently matches nothing. Sd.c's own subscribe path compares the same way (SD_ANY_MAJOR_VERSION or exact match), so major 1 is also what makes vsomeip's SUBSCRIBE acceptable here. Keep the per-method/per-event "version" (= SOME/IP header interface version) equal to this.
